A '''moon''' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Otavon XII]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ovoni]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Purge" /> situated in the [[Otavon system/Legends|Otavon system]] of the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]],<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> which was located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Region" /> [[Otavon XII's moon|Another]] natural [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] orbited alongside the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and, during a clear [[Star/Legends|sunset]], they could be seen orbiting close to their parent planet. When the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Battle of Otavon XII|dueled]] an Ovoni [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] named [[Hylon]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the moons hung overhead.<ref name="Purge" />

==Behind the scenes==
This moon briefly appeared in a [[2010]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] entitled [[Purge – The Hidden Blade|''Star Wars: Purge: The Hidden Blade'']], written by [[W. Haden Blackman]] and penciled by [[Chris Scalf]]. The comic was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Purge" /> on [[April 7]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54466/star_wars_purge_-_the_hidden_blade_2010_1|text=Star Wars: Purge - The Hidden Blade (2010) #1}}</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Otavon [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the moon, in grid square M-7.<ref name="Atlas Companion" />
